name: Nathan Eaton
why: Spirit Masters display board photographed into the 2007-08 scrapbook: a checkerboard of studio headshot cards and caption cards, each caption paired with the portrait in its own column of the panel. On the panel at PDF p. 28 the caption 'Nathan Eaton' sits top left and his portrait is the card directly below it; the pairing rule is confirmed on the same panel by Olivia Faulkner (caption top right, woman below) and Angelena Edwards (woman top centre, caption below), and on four further panels, fifteen pairs, with no contradiction. Identification is safe on the printed fields as well as the name: the board gives Fairdale, KY and a Marketing major, and the archive records Nathan Eaton in SGA in 2006-07 and as chair of Campus Improvements in 2007-08, so a junior on the 2007-08 board matches a student who entered in 2005.
caption_quote: Nathan Eaton / Fairdale, KY / Junior / Marketing major / First Year Spirit Master

name: Diane DeRosa-Reynolds
why: From the same display board, panel at PDF p. 27. Her caption sits at the foot of the right-hand column and her portrait is the card directly above it in that column; the panel confirms the rule twice more, Lauren Carter (portrait above, caption below, left column) and Clint Conrad (caption above, man below, centre column). The board is 2007-08 and the archive records her in SGA in 2005-06 and 2006-07, so the portrait is filed to her last recorded year and was taken one year after it. The printed fields fit: a junior in 2007-08 entered in 2005, which is the year she first appears in student government. The surname is hyphenated and unique in both lists.

name: Jean-Marie Lawson
why: The 1996-97 Spirit Masters member board, photographed page by page into the scrapbook. Each page carries one or two mounted colour studio portraits with a typed nameplate on card directly beneath its own frame, so the pairing is not a judgement call. Hers is the right-hand portrait on p. 8, nameplate 'Jean-Marie Lawson' centred under it; the left-hand portrait on the same page is separately plated 'Joy Fischer'. The board is 1996-97 and the archive records Jean-Marie Lawson in student government in 1996-97, the same year. The name is unique in both lists.

name: Darlene Lodmell
why: Same 1996-07 board, p. 9: hers is the right-hand mounted studio portrait, nameplate 'Darlene Lodmell' on card directly beneath its own frame. Handled with care because Carlene and Darlene Lodmell are two different people whom the archive has ruled must never be merged: the board plates them on facing pages, Darlene at the right of p. 9 and Carlene at the left of p. 10, each under her own frame, and the two women are plainly distinguishable in the frames, Darlene with long dark wavy hair past the shoulder and Carlene with a short curled bob. The board is 1996-97, the year the archive records Darlene Lodmell as SGA secretary, with Carlene as vice president.

name: Carlene Lodmell
why: An upgrade, not a new identification: she already carries a soft 150 dpi newsprint crop from the Herald of 8 April 1997, and this is the same year in colour studio work. Same 1996-97 board, p. 10: hers is the left-hand mounted studio portrait, nameplate 'Carlene Lodmell' on card directly beneath its own frame, with the right-hand portrait separately plated 'Jason Loehr'. The Lodmell care applies: her sister Darlene is plated on the facing page, p. 9 right, and the two frames are plainly different women, Carlene in a short curled bob and Darlene with long dark wavy hair. The board is 1996-97, the year the archive records Carlene Lodmell as SGA vice president. The new file is given its own name so the existing portrait is not overwritten; the editor can drop the Herald crop or keep both.
